stats.description: The stats, in the order the pause screen lists them and `spend` numbers them.

ContentId.description:
A content ID from the registry (ADR-026): asset, palette, part, preset, status or pattern.
Lowercase `snake_case`, at most 32 characters; the validator checks the format and that the
ID exists.

RunStat.description: One stat a point can raise.

description.description: What a point does, in words, at most `MAX_DESCRIPTION_CHARS` characters.

id.description: The stat's own ID, unique within the file.

limit.description: The most points the stat takes in a run, from 1 to `MAX_LIMIT`.

step.description: What one point adds, from 1 to `MAX_STEP` (`MAX_HP_STEP` for hit points).

title.description: The name the pause screen shows, 1 to `MAX_TITLE_CHARS` characters.

StatEffect.description:
What a point in a stat does, `step` times over. The closed list of version 0's effects;
percentages add up over every stat with the same effect and round down.

oneOf.description: `step` more hit points at most, and as many healed.
`step` percent more damage from every attack of the main character.

`step` percent faster attacks: a combo step's length divided by `1 + step / 100`
(ADR-070), each of its phases at least 1 tick.
A `step` percent shorter evade cooldown (at least 1 tick).

`step` percent more experience from every kill, rounded down (ADR-068: the build that
unlocks rarer stars sooner).
